title: Replace Dark Leather theme with logo-aligned Navy + Gold luxury branding (header, typography, cards, buttons, texture, logo)

requirements.text: Replace the current site-wide “Dark Leather Premium” design tokens with the new logo-aligned Navy + Gold luxury palette across the entire frontend, using the exact colors: Background #0F1B2D, Secondary Dark #141F33, Gold Accent #C8A24D, Soft Cream Text #F4EFE6, Muted Gold Divider #B9933C. Update global CSS variables and Tailwind theme usage so existing components (header, footer, pages, cards, forms) automatically inherit the new palette without introducing bright blue UI.

quotes: The user has uploaded 1 image(s): image.png.
Apply the exact color palette you listed (#0F1B2D, #141F33, #C8A24D, #F4EFE6, #B9933C) as the new global theme

acceptanceCriteria: Global background renders as dark navy (not brown/maroon) and primary accent renders as gold across all pages (Home, Products, Category, Catalogue, About, Contact).
Text is soft-cream on dark backgrounds with sufficient contrast; muted text is visibly subdued but readable.
Borders/dividers use muted gold tones rather than heavy/bright outlines.
No UI elements default to bright blue (links, focus states, buttons) unless explicitly part of the navy/gold system.

requirements.text: Upgrade the header into a more premium, luxury-style navigation: make the header visually lighter and more refined by using a transparent/overlay treatment on the Home hero (with subtle blur), increased spacing, thinner nav typography, and replace the current active-state “filled pill” with a gold underline (or similarly subtle gold indicator). Keep mobile navigation functional and consistent with the new premium styling.

quotes: Highlight “Products” with gold underline instead of filled box

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the header overlays the hero image with a subtle blur and does not appear as a flat opaque bar.
Active nav item is indicated via a subtle gold underline/marker (not a solid filled background) on both desktop and mobile menus.
Mobile menu open/close remains accessible (aria-label preserved) and readable on dark navy background.
Logo area and navigation have noticeably more breathing room than current header height/spacing.

requirements.text: Integrate the provided logo into the top-left of the header in place of (or alongside) the plain text site name, sized appropriately for a premium look (not oversized), with adequate padding/clear space. Ensure the logo remains sharp on retina displays and visually harmonizes with the new navy+gold palette.

quotes: Add your logo in top left

acceptanceCriteria: Header shows the MeghRaj Exports logo at top-left on desktop and mobile.
Logo is not cramped: padding/clear space is present around it, and it does not collide with nav/menu button.
Logo remains readable on dark background and does not appear as a white rectangle pasted on the page (transparent/clean edge handling).

requirements.text: Refine buttons site-wide to feel more premium: primary buttons should use gold background with navy text; secondary/outline buttons should use gold borders with cream text; hover should invert (gold ↔ navy) with smooth transitions and subtle elevation. Apply this consistently to key CTAs including “View Products”, “Request Catalogue”, “Send Inquiry”, and “Contact Us”.

quotes: Make it: Gold background, Dark navy text

acceptanceCriteria: Primary CTA buttons render with gold fill and navy text by default.
Hover/focus states invert colors smoothly (no jarring animations) and maintain accessibility (visible focus ring aligned to the theme).
Buttons across Home, Category, Catalogue, Contact pages follow a consistent style system (shape, radius, typography, shadow).

requirements.text: Reduce the “boxy template” feel on product/category cards and highlight blocks by removing heavy borders, using subtler shadows, and adding refined gold detailing (thin gold divider lines under section titles where appropriate). Add a restrained hover interaction (slight zoom + soft gold glow) to category cards and key cards while keeping motion subtle.

quotes: Add gold divider line under section title
Add hover effect: Slight zoom, Soft gold glow

acceptanceCriteria: Cards (e.g., Home highlights, Products category cards) no longer rely on thick borders to define shape; they use shadow and background separation instead.
Hover interactions are subtle and consistent (no large scaling); visual emphasis is via soft gold glow/accent.
Section titles that represent major content blocks can show thin gold dividers/separators consistent with #B9933C/#C8A24D.

requirements.text: Improve typography hierarchy to feel more “luxury”: increase heading presence (size/weight/letter-spacing choices) while keeping body text lighter with increased line-height and spacing. Ensure typography is consistent across pages and components (header, hero, section titles, accordions, form labels).

quotes: Headings: Use a refined serif font
Body text: Slightly lighter weight. More spacing between lines.

acceptanceCriteria: Headings read as premium editorial serif (existing serif is acceptable) with stronger hierarchy than current (more differentiation between H1/H2/H3).
Body copy has improved readability via line-height and spacing; no cramped paragraphs.
Navigation typography appears thinner/more refined than current while remaining readable.

requirements.text: Add subtle luxury detailing and depth across the site: implement thin gold separators between major sections and optional small gold accent markers for bullet-like lists where they exist, without clutter. Add a very subtle leather-like texture overlay on the main dark backgrounds at ~5% opacity so the navy is not perfectly flat.

quotes: Small gold accent dot before bullet points
Use a very subtle leather texture overlay at 5% opacity

acceptanceCriteria: Major page sections can be visually separated with thin gold lines/gradients consistent with the theme (not heavy rules).
Backgrounds show subtle texture depth (barely visible) and do not reduce text readability.
Texture overlay is subtle and not distracting; it remains consistent across pages using the main background.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose only).
Keep the app as a B2B inquiry/catalogue site: do not add pricing, cart, checkout, or e-commerce flows.
Do not serve images through the backend; use static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
nonGoals: Changing the product taxonomy hierarchy or category content structure.
Adding third-party auth beyond Internet Identity or adding external integrations.

required: Seamless subtle leather texture tile, dark navy-toned (leather-texture-tile.dim_1024x1024.png)
edits: Remove background to make a clean transparent logo (image.png > meghraj-logo-transparent.dim_800x800.png)
Create a gold-only logo variant suitable for dark navy backgrounds (image.png > meghraj-logo-gold.dim_800x800.png)
Create a simplified square mark for small usage (image.png > meghraj-mark-square.dim_512x512.png)
